title: Local metering guard checks the gateway URL path, not its host
description:
localMetering's comment says a non-Cloudflare gateway gets no metering. But gatewaytrace.GatewayIDs checks only the path shape /v1/<account>/<gateway>, and WriteExtension only requires '://', so an http:// or third-party host passes. Since m4t, pi then sends the Cloudflare account token in both Authorization and cf-aig-authorization to that host, and in cleartext over http. Failing input: factory_gateway_url=http://proxy.example/v1/a/b in ~/.ticfacrc. The operator sets this value, so this is not high, but the guard should require https and the gateway.ai.cloudflare.com host.
evidence: internal/gatewaytrace/trace.go:79-89; internal/exec/subprocess/pimeter.go:152,221-222
